extracted.intended_audience: Applicants preparing an NIH PHS 398 / K01 career development (K) grant application (biomedical researchers applying for NIH K01 awards)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and justify all components of an NIH PHS 398 K01 career development award resubmission, including budget (Research & Related), budget justification, human subjects, mentor/mentoring plan, research strategy, training plan, and required supplemental forms and appendices.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section A Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/Key Person — list prefix, name, project role, base salary, calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and Funds Requested for each senior/key person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form requires listing each Senior/Key Person with percent effort (calendar months), salary request, and fringe; includes 'Total Funds Requested for all Senior Key Persons in the attached file' and an area to attach file(s). Example on page shows PD/PI Lilliam Ambroggio with 9.0 calendar months and benefits calculated at 25%.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section B Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Other Personnel — itemize number of personnel by role (postdoctoral associates, graduate students, undergraduates, secretarial/clerical, etc.), months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and Funds Requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form collects totals for 'Total Number Other Personnel' and 'Total Other Personnel' costs; the Budget Justification should explain which personnel effort is covered by parent grants vs. the K01 (e.g., CRC effort covered in certain years).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section C Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment — list items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000; provide total funds requested for all equipment listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only equipment over $5,000 is listed. The Budget Justification here states 'No additional equipment will be purchased for this proposal' and documents access to institutional NMR spectrometers and associated per-sample charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section D Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel — provide domestic and foreign travel cost estimates separately and total travel cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget Justification should explain travel plans (e.g., meetings with mentors, national professional meetings, number of meetings per year, estimated per-meeting costs) and note which travel costs are covered by institutional 'professional' funds versus the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section E Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs — list Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and Number of Participants/Trainees; provide totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the project includes participants/trainees; form distinguishes these costs from personnel salary lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section F Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — itemize Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, and other direct cost categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget Justification must explain per-item costs (e.g., per-sample NMR assay costs, home urine collection kits with per-kit cost and sample counts across years, 16S rRNA and PCR testing per-sample costs).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section G Direct Costs and Section H Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs — total of Sections A through F. H. Indirect Costs — specify indirect cost type, indirect cost rate (%), indirect cost base ($), and Funds Requested. Provide cognizant federal agency contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indirect costs must be computed per the RFA; example shows 'Federal (MTDC)' base and an 8% rate (as specified in the RFA) with a cognizant agency contact listed. The institution may waive usual indirect costs but must include the RFA-specified rate if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget: Section I Total Direct and Indirect Costs and Section J Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs — sum of Direct Costs (G) and Indirect Costs (H). J. Fee — funds requested for fee (often 0.00).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals. The example shows Fee = 0.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification Attachment (K)
rubrics_metrics.description: K. Budget Justification — attach one file that justifies the proposed budget, describing why requested costs are specific to the research and training plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only attach one file. The Budget Justification should explain personnel roles and percent effort, benefits calculation, equipment access and per-sample assay costs, supplies with per-item costing and yearly distribution, software needs and licensing rationale, travel plans and funding sources, and any institutional cost-sharing (e.g., divisional professional funds). Example file name provided: BUDGET_JUSTIFICATION_AmbroggioK01_2016_07_08.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification: Personnel salary and benefits detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe personnel (PI, CRC, data management team, etc.), calendar months or percent effort, specific responsibilities, and benefits/fringe rate used to calculate costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide year-by-year salary and benefits charged to the award for each person (example: CRC salary/benefits amounts per year; Data Management team amounts per year). Clarify which years are covered by other grants and when K01 will support effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification: Use and justification of shared/institutional equipment and per-sample costs
rubrics_metrics.description: If no equipment is purchased, specify institutional resources used (e.g., NMR spectrometers at partner institutions) and per-sample charges for instrument time and spectrometrist/technician effort.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List training arrangements (hands-on training, number of training samples) and per-sample costs at each site (example: $317 per sample year 1 via UMICH including personnel; $30 per sample at CCHMC years 1-3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification: Supplies and consumables itemization
rubrics_metrics.description: List supplies needed with counts, per-item cost, and year-by-year distribution (e.g., Home Urine Collection Kits: 150 kits at $20 each; 16S rRNA testing: 50 samples at $35 each; Viral/bacterial PCR for NP swabs for controls: 145 samples at $100 each).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals and allocate by budget year(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification: Software justification
rubrics_metrics.description: List required statistical/bioinformatics software, indicate whether available at institution or must be purchased, and provide cost justification (e.g., Mplus academic license $895 in year 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State why software is necessary (e.g., specific analyses not well developed in other packages) and whether institutional access exists (e.g., SAS provided, MetScape publicly available, Chenomx available through collaborators).

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs and RFA-specified rate
rubrics_metrics.description: State indirect cost rate applied (if institution waives usual rate, indicate the RFA-specified rate used).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'CCHMC has agreed to waive its usual indirect cost and has included indirect charges at 8% as specified in the RFA.' Provide cognizant federal agency contact information on form.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Human Subjects Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether project involves human subjects, whether it is a clinical trial, and if Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial applies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If human subjects are involved, complete Protection of Human Subjects (separate section), Data Safety Monitoring Plan, and inclusion tables. Example shows 'Clinical Trial? No' on the form. If human subjects, issues such as pre-antibiotic sample status, missing clinical variables, and how missing data will be handled should be addressed in Research Plan and Human Subjects protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Vertebrate Animals Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used and whether euthanasia is performed consistent with AVMA guidelines; if not, provide justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes' to euthanasia, state method consistency with AVMA or provide justification for deviation.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether program income is anticipated during the budget period and, if yes, use provided format to reflect amount and source(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'No', leave section blank. If 'Yes', provide amounts and sources per budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Human Embryonic Stem Cells
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the project involves human embryonic stem cells; if yes, list registration numbers of specific cell lines or indicate that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers per NIH stem cell registry or check box that a registry line will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Inventions and Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether inventions and patents exist for the project and whether they have been previously reported (for renewals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', answer follow-up question about prior reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: If changing project director/principal investigator or grantee institution, provide names and details of the former PD/PI or former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use designated section to document changes for administrative processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form: Required Application Components
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplemental form requires multiple attachments and sections including: Introduction (for resubmissions), Candidate Information and Goals, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List (renewals), Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research, Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring, Mentor/Co-Mentor Plans and Statements, Letters of Support from Collaborators/Contributors/Consultants, Description of Institutional Environment, Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development, Protection of Human Subjects, Data Safety Monitoring Plan, Inclusion of Women and Minorities, Inclusion of Children, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Resource Sharing, Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, and Appendix materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each item must be completed and uploaded as indicated. The example application lists specific filenames for each required attachment and includes Appendix files (e.g., inclusion/exclusion criteria, home urine collection instructions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Development / Training Plan expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Candidate's section must describe background, career goals and objectives, a plan for training and mentorship to gain independence (e.g., hands-on NMR training, courses, bioinformatics training), and a timeline toward generating R01 support (e.g., submit first R01 by year 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers look for feasibility and specificity: course load must be realistic, mentorship and training must provide experiential learning, plans to gain independence (mentoring meetings frequency, roles) and a clear timeline (years 1-5) toward an R01. The narrative should also describe prior relevant experience that supports capacity to execute the plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentoring Plan and Mentor Qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a mentoring committee with named mentors/co-mentors, institutional affiliations, associated aims/goals, meeting frequency and format, area(s) of expertise, and defined roles for each mentor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentors should have a record of publication, funding, and mentoring. The plan should explain how each mentor complements the candidate and contributes to training (example: primary mentor weekly meetings, other mentors monthly or biweekly). Reviewers assess whether the mentorship team is appropriate and whether roles are clearly allocated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan: Specific Aims and Restructuring per Reviewer Feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Plan must include Specific Aims and a Research Strategy; respond to prior reviewer critiques (e.g., restructure aims per panel suggestion, align preliminary data with aims, present parent study data, specify sample timing relative to antibiotics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address reviewer weaknesses explicitly in the Introduction/Resubmission Explanation (example: reorganized aims so Aim 1 examines diurnal variation in healthy children, Aim 2 differentiates bacterial/viral pneumonia from healthy, Aim 3 compares longitudinal changes). Present preliminary data tables/figures and clarify sample timing and sample size/grouping rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of Clinical and Laboratory Data Missingness and Inclusion Thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify which clinical variables will be collected, how missing clinical data will be handled (e.g., complete case analysis), and set thresholds for metabolite inclusion in analyses (e.g., include metabolites reported in at least 90% of samples).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide plan in Research Strategy/Methods for dealing with missingness and for selecting analytes for multivariable modeling; reviewers expect transparency about missing data and inclusion criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of Confounders (e.g., prior antibiotic use)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify how potential confounders (such as prior antibiotic exposure) will be measured and incorporated into multivariable models for aims comparing pathogen groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report rates of prior antibiotic use in preliminary cohorts and state analytic adjustments to account for it (example: 23% had antibiotics prior to ED visit; models will adjust for prior antibiotic use).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix and Supporting Files
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix can include supporting documents like inclusion/exclusion criteria and specimen collection instructions; provide file names and upload as part of the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Appendix slots (e.g., 21_Appendix_A_Inclusion_and_Exclusion_Criteria.pdf; 21_Appendix_B_home_urine_collection_instruction.pdf) to attach study-specific procedures and materials that support human subjects protection and protocol implementation.
